source: GitHub PR metadata and discussion at snapshot; no model review performed
scope: read-only metadata, no Proffera code sent to ReviewForge or OpenAI
notes: Comment counts include summaries and follow-ups; they are not true positive metrics. Many comments may refer to earlier commits. ReviewForge still needs side-by-side evaluation of verified bugs, false positives, PR coverage, latency and API cost. Do not infer performance parity from these counts.
